ops.label: Data
ops.detail: What the systems give us today - three daily exports, one live ticket app, and a set of hand-maintained spreadsheets

ops.label: Bettercommerce
ops.detail: Order line grain, daily CSV, 16 columns. Carries the customer-promised EDD

ops.label: Increff
ops.detail: Order item grain, daily CSV, 83 columns. The full warehouse clock and its own SLA breach flag

ops.label: Clickpost
ops.detail: Shipment/AWB grain, daily CSV, 126 columns. Courier, attempts, failure reasons, RTO, delivery. Forward and reverse arrive mixed

ops.label: Logisupport
ops.detail: Live CS ticket app - Apps Script front end on Firestore. Tickets, timeline, handoffs, 3PL, users. Migrates into the new system

ops.label: Manual spreadsheets
ops.detail: Zone map, pincode-partner assignment, rate cards with zone and overheads, serviceability, invoice breakup at AWB level. All hand-maintained

ops.label: Package master
ops.detail: Standardised weight and dimensions by package type; orders map to a package type. Not joined to shipment data today

cells.carries: Order no, order date, EDD, line status, tracking no, payment method, ship-to city and pincode, paid amount, units
cells.prob: SKU detail dropped from the current export. order_date is UTC while the other two sources are IST

cells.carries: Full warehouse clock: channel order, SLA time, release, invoice, manifest create and close, handover, shipment close, delivered. SLA Breach Y/N, AWB, SKU/category/style/colour/size, qty ladder, amounts, pincode
cells.prob: About 20 qty columns arrive empty. Brand casing varies three ways. One fulfilment location only

cells.carries: Courier, 16 statuses, pickup date, delivery attempts 1-5 with reasons, pickup attempts 1-3 with reasons, delivery date, RTO mark and delivered dates, RVP reason, hub in/out scans, courier EDD, stuck-in-lifecycle flag, invoice and COD value
cells.prob: Shipping Cost is 0.0 on every row. Weight and dimensions are placeholders. Zone and Pricing Zone are empty. Committed SLA filled on about a third of rows. Forward and reverse arrive in one file

cells.grain: Ticket - live Firestore, Apps Script front end
cells.carries: Collections tickets, timeline, handoffs, threepl, users. Nine issue types, CS/Logistics/Warehouse owner ledger with per-hand ageing, Critical and High-ageing priority, 3PL forwarding with channel and external ticket id, media
cells.prob: Sits apart from the logistics data. Order id and AWB are free-text fields on the ticket, so the join back to a shipment is not enforced

cells.carries: Zone map, pincode to zone mapping, partner-pincode assignment, partner rate cards with zone and overhead detail, serviceability, invoice data and vendor invoice breakup at AWB level
cells.prob: No history, no validation, and each one has a single owner. These are the files the system has to absorb

cells.carries: Weight and dimensions by package type; every order maps to a package type
cells.prob: Not joined to the shipment data today, so charged weight cannot yet be disputed

cells.by: BC EDD as the number partners are measured against, Clickpost delivery, attempt and RTO timestamps, Increff warehouse clock and its SLA breach flag
cells.missing: The agreed pickup cut-off per partner. No Lost or Damaged status appears in the data - stuck-in-lifecycle is the only proxy

cells.by: Courier failure reason and timestamp, first and last, plus attempt counts on both delivery and pickup
cells.missing: The customer contact log - who called, what the customer said, and what action went back to the courier. Nothing records the loop itself

cells.by: City, lane, order value and partner are all derivable from the three files
cells.missing: Zone. Clickpost's Zone, Pricing Zone and Uploaded Pincode Zone are empty on every row - the zone map is a spreadsheet today

cells.by: The partner actually assigned is visible per AWB
cells.missing: The allocation rule in force and its change history, and serviceability by partner and pincode. Both hand-maintained
The cost half. Shipping Cost is 0.0 on every Clickpost row, so nothing rankable on cost exists until invoices and rate cards are in

cells.by: Nothing in the three daily exports
cells.missing: Partner invoices at AWB grain, rate cards with zone and overheads, payment status, and a real weight to dispute charged weight against

cells.by: Logisupport already carries issue type, owner ledger with per-hand ageing, priority rule, 3PL forwarding and resolution
cells.missing: Nothing new to collect - the work is migrating it in and binding tickets to orders and AWBs properly

cells.by: The three files share join keys: BC order no = Increff channel order id = Clickpost reference number, and Increff AWB = Clickpost AWB
cells.missing: Nothing new. A stuck order shows as a row present in one source and absent from the next - the check simply has never been run as a daily alert
